name: How does AKN Design Group handle design coordination throughout a project?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group handle design coordination throughout a project?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group handles design coordination through our integrated design-build process, where we manage everything from initial consultation and CAD-supported layouts to construction and final walkthrough. We assign a dedicated project team to ensure consistent communication and oversight, acting as your single point of coordination. This approach consolidates all design, planning, and construction responsibilities under one experienced team, which streamlines decision-making, minimizes potential conflicts between design intent and construction reality, and ensures your vision is maintained from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group uses an integrated design-build process with a dedicated project team to manage all aspects of design and construction coordination.
